longDescription: Two working protocols built for a BattleCON DIY project: the Arena Referee forces a rules-briefing and glossary load before any match simulation, ruling, or battle report, enforcing the six rules, the state-machine simulation discipline, and the finisher switch-style protocol; the DIY Guardian enforces the supreme principles for design and localization work (official frame as boundary, citable precedents, full information disclosure, three-pass rule reconciliation, verbatim transcription of physical cards). All skills set rules and point to living data in the project memory store; the user's rulings always take precedence.
tryPrompts: Run a match and write the battle report
Review whether this DIY character design is legal
Rule the full resolution order of this attack

arena-referee.description: Mandatory startup protocol for simulations, rulings and battle reports: load the rules briefing and glossary first, then apply the six rules and the state-machine discipline

diy-guardian.description: Supreme-principle guard for DIY design and localization: citable precedents, open information, three-pass reconciliation, verbatim card transcription
